purpose: Ground-truth locks + patterns from stem/ear passes to improve tempo/key/section quality

session_locked_verified.title: Fireflies in Tar
session_locked_verified.lesson: Bass stem overrode mix G min → D min 7A

session_locked_verified.title: Frank & Folks
session_locked_verified.lesson: Stem AC 0.76–0.82 at ~74; machine 98 was weak secondary (~0.20). Bass → D min not E maj

session_locked_verified.title: ooh...ah...Alive
session_locked_verified.lesson: Do NOT auto-double. Stem+ear primary ~59; 117 optional only. Key G#→C#m (user+inst)

session_locked_verified.title: Pew Pew - General bum wing
session_locked_verified.lesson: Stem strongest ~63.8; user locked 64 (not forced 128). Sections machine intro/outro wrong by large margin

tempo: Low mix confidence (<0.35) is a strong predictor of wrong BPM (Alive 0.28, Pew 0.19, Frank 0.32)
False mid-BPM (80–95) appears when half-grid (~55–65) or slow primary is correct (Pew 85→64, Alive 92→59)
Auto-doubling half peaks is WRONG when the groove is ballad/half-time primary (Alive, Pew user choice 64)
Auto-doubling is RIGHT only when double matches kick grid and ear (not assumed)
Strong stem drums AC at X with weak AC at ~1.3–1.6X → prefer X (Frank 74 vs 98)
When stem AC at X and 2X both present: ask ear — do not algorithmically force
key: Bass stem + 30–250 Hz pitch-class histogram outweigh full-mix chroma
Machine high keyConfidence can still be wrong (Alive G# min conf 0.96 vs locked C#m)
Relative/parallel swaps common: G min vs D min (Fireflies); G# min vs C#m (Alive)
Same Camelot neighborhood often both valid colours (C maj / F maj Pew) — lock needs ear
Instrumental-only key can drift (pads); never lock without bass weight
sections: vocalOnsetSec is not equal to intro end (Pew: onset 6.3 vs real intro 23.1)
outroOnsetSec can be early by 10–15s+ (Pew 187 vs 202)
Always ear-check intro/outro boundaries before lyric sync / block follow

measurement_series_v1.name: God series — locked catalogue calibration scan
measurement_series_v1.when: After any stem pack OR before locking from mix-only

steps.name: Drums onset AC family
steps.method: Spectral flux → autocorrelation 50–200 BPM on drums stem body (20–70% duration)

steps.name: Inst/Bass onset confirm
steps.method: Same AC on instrumental + bass; agree if within 2 BPM of drums primary family

steps.name: Ear gate (mandatory)
steps.method: Metronome A/B: primary peak vs double vs mix estimate

steps.name: Inst/Other contrast
steps.method: Chroma on inst+other; flag if differs from bass by >1 Camelot step

steps.name: Ear gate key
steps.method: Drone/chords A/B bass-winner vs mix estimate vs pad key

steps.name: Intro boundary
steps.method: Mark first structural downbeat / vocal or motif entry — not energy onset alone

steps.name: Outro boundary
steps.method: Mark final section start (strip-down / last chorus end) by ear

steps.name: Master snapshot
steps.method: After MASTER: LUFS, TP, crest, eligibility, qa_vector if QualityGate present

decision_rules: Never lock tempo if only mix conf < 0.35 without T1–T3
Never auto-prefer 2× peak without T3 ear pass
Never lock key from mix-only when K3 conflict is true without K4
Section machine defaults are provisional until S1–S2

tempo.frank_pattern: if stem_ac(primary)>0.6 and stem_ac(mix_bpm)<0.25 → lock family of primary
